title: DVIDS - Video - Wild Bagram
description: The Department of Defense and the U.S. Department of Agriculture continually implement aviation safety programs to keep service members safe. One of those programs is the Bird/Animal Aircraft Strike Hazard or BASH program.
keywords: PD US Air Force, Videos by the Defense Visual Information Distribution Service, Bird control in aviation, 2016 at Bagram Air Base, Videos by the United States Department of Agriculture
